Unpack **1.2.0** is a Windows desktop tool for archives, Xbox 360 ISO conversion, a game library, DLC and title updates, USB copy, and LAN FTP to a modded console.

## Downloads

- `Unpack_1.2.0_x64-setup.exe` — per-user installer. It does not need administrator rights. Windows SmartScreen may warn because the file is unsigned: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- `Unpack-portable.zip` — unzip anywhere and run `Unpack.exe`. Keep `WebView2Loader.dll` and `7za.exe` in the same folder.

WebView2 is already part of Windows 10 and 11.

## What’s new in 1.2.0

- **Discord Rich Presence.** While Unpack is open, Discord can show Playing Unpack with the current tool and job. Nothing is uploaded; it only talks to the local Discord client. Turn it off in Settings.
- For the large artwork, upload an image named `unpack` in the Discord Developer Portal. Text still works without it.

## Also in 1.1.1 / 1.1.0

- Full Xbox 360 and original Xbox TitleID catalog (5,908 titles)
- Disc 1 and Disc 2 convert into one playable XEX folder, or one TitleID GOD set
- Send to Xbox skips `launch.ini` unless you opt in; LAN only

Use files you own. Back up `launch.ini` before you convert or copy anything. See `DISCLAIMER.txt`.
